tools.name: funder_search
tools.description: Find funders by jurisdiction, cause area, size band and region. Results are ordered by how much each funder has given toward the requested cause and region in its recent public filings: larger, steadier and more widely giving funders first; funders that give mostly to one recipient or to their own r

tools.name: funder_profile
tools.description: Return one funder's plain-language profile, computed from active global observations. Each fact carries its public source name and the date it was last verified.

tools.name: opportunity_search
tools.description: Find open and upcoming opportunities by jurisdiction, cause area, region and deadline. Ordered by deadline (soonest first, rolling and unknown deadlines last), then name, then slug. Results are not ranked against an organization. Use the slug of a result with opportunity_detail.

tools.name: opportunity_detail
tools.description: Return one opportunity: plain-language eligibility, deadline, and a link to the funder's own page.
